quarterly_data.quarter: Prysmian press release: Prysmian completes Xtera acquisition and accelerates (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Prysmian completed the acquisition of Xtera Topco Limited, a UK- and U.S.-based turnkey submarine telecom systems specialist with proprietary repeater technology (solutions deployed in more than 60 countries), through its joint venture with Fincantieri (Prysmian 80%, Fincantieri 20%). In September Xtera was selected by EXA Infrastructure to provide the optical engineering and wet and dry plant for EXA Meridian, a new 6,552 km transatlantic submarine cable between New Jersey (U.S.) and Brean (UK) with 24 fiber pairs and more than 500 Tbps of scalable capacity, targeted to enter service in 2029; its cables will be made at Prysmian's submarine telecom center in Nordenham, Germany, where Prysmian is doubling production capacity and looking for up to 300 new employees. Raul Gil, EVP Transmission: Prysmian is exploring the addition of a new dedicated submarine telecom cable-laying vessel.
quarterly_data.figure: EXA Meridian 6,552 km, 24 fiber pairs, more than 500 Tbps, service 2029; Nordenham capacity doubling
